items.title: Chitwan Rhinos knock Kathmandu Gorkhas out and progress to Qualifier 2
items.summary: Chitwan defeated Kathmandu by 61 runs and entered Qualifier 2, where Sudurpaschim Royals are waiting. Chitwan and Sudurpaschim will vie for a spot in the final on Thursday.

items.title: Gold price slides by Rs78,400 a tola in 10 months
items.summary: Stronger dollar and expectations of US interest rate hikes push international prices down. Traders say domestic rates could fall to Rs250,000 if current conditions persist.

items.title: Stop the repeated arbitrary removal of police leadership
items.summary: Successive governments have politicised police leadership, undermining institutional stability and professionalism.

items.title: MBBS entrance exam results published
items.summary: The Medical Education Commission has published the results of the October 31 entrance examination for students seeking admission to MBBS programmes in the 2026-27 academic year.

items.title: Mishara’s record century sends Chitwan into Qualifier 2

items.title: Police is my friend?

items.title: Saudis preparing for Yemen campaign to last well into 2027
items.summary: The renewed conflict has become the ​most active front in the wider Iran war, killing and wounding thousands and displacing hundreds of thousands in Yemen while derailing Saudi Arabia’s efforts to draw ‌in non-oil investment and host global events.

items.title: Bangladesh deploys paramilitary as unrest grows over Hasina’s return
items.summary: Last week, Awami League announced a week-long programme of protests and rallies to mobilise support for ​Hasina’s return, culminating in a nationwide lockdown on November 19.

items.title: Ani Choying Dolma takes office as vice-chair of Lumbini Development Trust

items.summary: The Sri Lankan batter struck an unbeaten century and shared a 154-run stand with captain Ravi Bopara as Chitwan Rhinos set Kathmandu Gorkhas a target of 205 in the NPL Eliminator.

items.title: Madhesh government formation remains uncertain as deadline approaches

items.title: Supreme Court sets November 23 hearing on Dan Bahadur Karki’s removal as police chief
items.summary: The court has sought a government explanation and given priority to the case, but declined to issue an interim order reinstating the former inspector general, allowing his successor to continue in office.
